race.comment: FIRERATED (2) switches to the turf but was good when he scored by a long neck last start over this journey at Ballarat Synthetic. Has a good record at this trip with a win and one minor placing from his three attempts and he has some upside. Leading player. CHICAGO BLUES (10) put the writing on the wall with a much better effort at Wangaratta last start, hitting the line well to miss narrowly. Race fit now so could go one better. ANIA (9) has been racing consistently and is suited returning to a track and trip where she has won two of three attempts. MAMUNO (11) has been readied for the return with a couple of trials so keep him safe.
